text:
Emma L: thinking about the upgrade path for really old air-gapped clusters — we need a safe operator-side backfill plan for metadata/grandfathering so installs that skipped versions don't break on activation.
Raj P: agree. main failure mode I've seen is operator tries to apply a staged manifest but required seeds/flags missing -> admin stuck.
Sasha M: can we make the operator detect 'legacy' installs on first contact and create a one-time migration job? minimal surface: noop if already present.
Emma L: that's the idea. concerns: size of backfill payload, security (we're pushing new keys/markers), and operator UX when admin wants to opt-out.
Mike R: option: backfill via checksum-only manifests (tiny) that instruct node to pull full blobs from offline media. operator just flips state. avoids shipping big bundles.
Olivia C: +1 on checksum instr. Also we should record a per-node 'grandfathered_versions' list so future upgrades can skip reapplying.
Raj P: what about signature chain changes? older nodes may not understand new sig format. need dual-sig verification for a window.
Emma L: plan sketch: 1) detect legacy install, 2) create ephemeral backfill manifest (checksums + minimal metadata), 3) operator emits a clear audit log and waits for admin ack (or auto after N hours), 4) node applies local sidecar to fetch blobs and completes.
Sasha M: UI question: how do admins approve in airgap? often console not accessible. maybe expose a file-based 'accept-grace' token they can drop into /var/lib/redwood/operator/approve_backfill.
Olivia C: file token seems pragmatic. also include a dry-run mode so operator can emit a delta report first.
Mike R: failure handling: if backfill fails, operator should revert state marker to pre-backfill and not mark bundle activated. include retry with exponential backoff.
Raj P: we need to be careful about cluster-wide vs per-node. backfill job should be per-node and idempotent. global activation only after quorum.
Emma L: agreed. add a safety gate: operator collects per-node success counts and requires X% before flipping global activation. X configurable, default 100 -> enterprise can relax.
Sasha M: sample operator snippet: ```yaml
backfill:
  mode: checksum-only
  require_ack_files: true
  quorum_pct: 100
```
Emma L: security: keys. If we're retrofitting new KMS metadata, operator should never send raw keys. Instead send key-wrapping instructions and require admin-provided wrapping key present on node.
Olivia C: note for docs: explain rollback playbook for partial backfills, include CLI to list nodes that failed and copy approve token.
Mike R: test plan: create lab cluster three-major-versions-behind, simulate seed missing, run backfill, test powercut during apply.
Raj P: we should also version the backfill manifest schema and document compat table.
Emma L: ok next steps: I'll draft RFC with diagrams and state machine, include file-token UX and quorum defaults. Raj can add signature compatibility section, Sasha will outline operator API changes, Mike will write runbook tests, Olivia will draft docs/CLI copy.
Sasha M: SGTM. cc @deploy-bot to start a canary once we have a prototype.
deploy-bot: noted: will queue a canary job when prototype branch 'airgap/backfill-operator' is ready. status updates here. :robot_face:
Olivia C: thanks — I'll start doc skeleton and link to RFC PR when Emma posts it. :thumbsup:
